description: This file is a header (.h) file defining the API for TR-069 device IP diagnostics trace route hop information. It declares functions to retrieve trace route hop details like host name, host address, error code, and round trip times, along with associated documentation and macros.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_Host
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname or IP address for a specific trace route hop, resolving DNS if possible.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_HostAddress
methods.description: Provides the last IP address of the hop, with optional hostname information.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_ErrorCode
methods.description: Returns the ICMP error code associated with the trace route hop.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_RTTimes
methods.description: Provides round trip times for the hop in milliseconds as a comma-separated list.
